answer: Mechanism: Violet-Lotus Zenith Nonce Lattice. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon yields a VDF seed; an agent’s action must carry a VDF proof over (seed, action hash, unique lotus-violet nonce). The verifier rejects any reused nonce or proof, so answers cannot be replayed. Sybils need N distinct proofs per zenith epoch; cost is N× VDF compute and memory, with parallel identities adding linear hardware/time rather than sharing one credential.
